newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore investments in China's Hebei seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Singapore investments in China's Hebei seen rising.

text.p: Singapore's investments in China's northeast province of Hebei are expected to rise by 30 to 40 percent in 1997 from the US$80 million registered last year, a senior Hebei official said on Friday.
"We are projecting a growth rate of between 30-40 percent," Zheng Yin Yuan, the Vice Secretary General of the People's Government of Hebei Province, told a news conference.
He was part of a 200-member delegation from 11 Hebei cities led by the province's vice-governor, Guo Hong Qi, seeking to attract more investment from Singapore.
Under China's 9th five-year plan, Hebei intends to launch 338 major projects worth 256.5 billion renminbi and to attract foreign investment of US$10 billion, provincial officials said
